newsitem.title: ROMANIA: RADIO ROMANIA AFTERNOON HEADLINES AT 4 PM.
newsitem.headline: RADIO ROMANIA AFTERNOON HEADLINES AT 4 PM.

text.p: * Romania's President Emil Constantinescu started talks with parties represented in parliament on the Romanian- Ukrainian treaty, initialled on May 3 in Kiev.
Constantinescu said the date for the signing of the Romanian-Ukrainian has yet to be decided.
* Romania's interests are not affected by the Romanian-Ukrainian treaty, Foreign Minister Adrian Severin said after talks with Constantinescu.
* The centrist rulling coalition Democratic Convention said it supported the treaty with Ukraine. -- Bucharest Newsroom 40-1 3120264
